t: You're looking at Fulham Library, a Grade II listed building at 598 Fulham Road. It was built in 1908 to designs by the architect Henry Hare, though a library has stood on this site since at least 1894. Hare was born in Scarborough in Yorkshire and educated in Sheffield and Harrogate before becoming an architect. So this is a public library with a long local history, and the building you see today is more than a century old.
